BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                  OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
In the Matter of Union Electric Company d/b/a )
Ameren Missouri’s Tariff to Adjust its Revenues )         Case No. ER-2026-0291
for Electric Service                            )
                                                )

                   ORDER SETTING LOCAL PUBLIC HEARINGS

Issue Date: November 20, 2026                             Effective Date: November 20, 2026

       Union Electric Company d/b/a Ameren Missouri submitted tariff sheets on

June 26, 2026, to produce an annual increase in its electric base rates of approximately

$343 million. On October 9, 2026, Ameren Missouri, the Staff of the Commission (Staff), and

the Office of the Public Counsel (Public Counsel) filed a proposed local public hearing

schedule with locations. The Commission will adopt that schedule with certain

modifications.

       THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

       1.     The Commission’s Public Policy and Outreach Department shall make an

informal presentation and conduct a question-and-answer session for the public at the

beginning of each local public hearing. Comments to the Commission from the public will

begin at the conclusion of the question-and-answer session.

       2.     Ameren Missouri, Staff, and Public Counsel shall make a representative

available to address substantive issues during the question-and-answer sessions. Any other

party may also choose to have a representative present.
           3.       Any person may participate at any of the hearings, but are encouraged to

attend the hearing closest to their service area for the most relevant information. Comments

at each hearing may be limited to three minutes per person.

          4.       In-person local public hearings shall be held as follows 1:

              a.     To attend a virtual local public hearing by telephone, at the
              time of the hearing call toll free 1-855-718-6621, listen to the prompt
              and enter the meeting number/access code set out above, followed by

              b.    To attend a virtual local public hearing by video/internet visit
              the website at www.webex.com or download the Cisco WebEx
              Meetings application. At hearing time, enter the corresponding
              meeting number/access code and password listed above.

       6.     To facilitate an orderly presentation that can be preserved for the record,

members of the public who wish to participate in the virtual public hearings should register,

but are not required to register, by sending their first and last name, phone number, email

address, and the hearing they wish to attend to pscinfo@psc.mo.gov, or by calling

(800) 392-4211 by 5:00 p.m. the day before the hearing they wish to attend.

       7.     Any persons needing an accommodation to participate in the hearings as

addressed by the Americans with Disabilities Act should contact the Missouri Public Service

Commission at least three days prior to the hearing at one of the following numbers:

Consumer Services Hotline 1-800-392-4211 or TDD Hotline 1-800-829-7541.

       8.     Comments may also be submitted to the Commission in writing by mail to the

Missouri Public Service Commission, P.O. Box 360, Jefferson City, Missouri 65102, or
 electronically       using    the     Commission’s       electronic     filing   system      at

https://psc.mo.gov/General/Submit_Comments. When submitting comments please

reference Case No. ER-2026-0291.

       9.        No later than ten days before the local public hearings, Ameren Missouri shall

provide notice of the hearings to each of its customers. The parties shall jointly file language

to include in the local public hearing notice no later than November 30, 2026.

       10.       So that everyone has a chance to speak, comments at the hearings may be

limited to three minutes per person.

       11.       The Commission’s Public Policy and Outreach Department shall make notice

of this order available to the members of the media and the General Assembly representing

customers in Ameren Missouri’s electric service areas.

       12.       The Commission’s Data Center shall provide a copy of this order to the county

commission for each county in Ameren Missouri’s service area.

       13.       This order shall be effective when issued.
